question: Où l’Anneau Unique a-t-il été forgé et pourquoi devait-il être détruit à cet endroit ?
justification: Ces documents décrivent la forge de l’Anneau à Orodruin, la condition nécessaire à sa destruction et le rôle de Frodo dans l’accomplissement de cette tâche.

references.passage: Sauron forged the One Ring in the fires of Orodruin.
The Ring could only be destroyed in the fires where it had originally been forged.
The One Ring would be forged in Mount Doom.
Gollum fell into the fire with the Ring, thus destroying the Ring.

question: Comment Narsil est-elle devenue Andúril et quelle importance cette transformation a-t-elle pour Aragorn ?
justification: Les articles relient les fragments de Narsil à leur reforgement à Rivendell, au nom Andúril et à l’héritage d’Aragorn comme héritier d’Isildur.

references.passage: Andúril was the name for the sword Narsil after its reforging for Aragorn.
Narsil was reforged by Elven smiths of Rivendell, and Aragorn renamed it Andúril.
The shards were reforged as Andúril for Aragorn, heir of Isildur.
Elrond delivered to Aragorn the shards of Narsil as heirlooms of his House.

question: Pourquoi le Conseil d’Elrond a-t-il conduit à la formation de la Communauté de l’Anneau ?
justification: Le Conseil décide du destin de l’Anneau, désigne Frodo comme porteur et organise un groupe de neuf marcheurs pour l’accompagner.

references.passage: The main purpose of the council was to discuss what should be done with the One Ring.
Nine walkers would counter the Nine Riders.
Frodo volunteered to be the Ring-bearer, and a Fellowship was formed to protect him.

question: Quelles décisions ont provoqué la rupture de la Communauté à Parth Galen ?
justification: Les documents décrivent le choix entre Mordor et Minas Tirith, la tentative de Boromir de prendre l’Anneau et la séparation de Frodo et Sam du reste du groupe.

references.passage: They had to choose whether to go to Mordor or to Minas Tirith.
Boromir attacked Frodo after asking him to lend him the Ring.
Boromir attempted to persuade the Council to let him take the One Ring to Gondor.
Sam was the only member of the Fellowship to remain with Frodo.

question: Quel rôle Samwise joue-t-il dans la réussite de la quête ?
justification: La réponse nécessite de relier la fidélité de Sam, son rôle de compagnon, son port temporaire de l’Anneau et son aide à Frodo dans Mordor.

references.passage: Sam was the only one to remain with Frodo to the end of the journey.
Sam took the Ring, rescued Frodo, and returned the Ring to him.
Sam rescued Frodo and the Hobbits reached the Crack of Doom.
Sam bore the Ring himself for a short time, but never gave in to its power.
Frodo Baggins destroyed the One Ring and Mordor fell.

question: Comment les forces de Rohan ont-elles remporté la bataille du Hornburg ?
justification: Les articles décrivent l’attaque d’Isengard, la défense du Hornburg, l’arrivée des renforts et l’intervention des Huorns.

references.passage: The attacking Isengard-host was defeated by the Rohirrim led by Théoden and Erkenbrand.
Helm’s Deep became the refuge of the Rohirrim and the keep was besieged.
Gandalf led the Westfold forces to the Deep, breaking the siege.

question: Pourquoi la bataille des Champs du Pelennor constitue-t-elle un tournant de la guerre ?
justification: La bataille brise le siège de Minas Tirith, inflige une défaite majeure aux forces de Mordor et entraîne la mort du Roi-Sorcier.

references.passage: The Battle of the Pelennor Fields was the greatest battle of the War of the Ring.
The three armies were able to break the siege in the decisive Battle of the Pelennor Fields.
The siege was broken by the Battle of the Pelennor Fields.
Éowyn slew the Witch-king with Merry’s aid.

question: Comment la géographie de Mordor influence-t-elle la stratégie de Sauron ?
justification: Ces documents relient les montagnes, les passages, le Black Gate, Osgiliath et Minas Tirith à la stratégie militaire de Sauron.

references.passage: Mordor was protected by three enormous mountain ridges.
The Black Gate was built to control the north-western entrance.
The eastern part of Osgiliath was occupied by Sauron’s forces.
Minas Tirith was besieged after the crossings of Anduin were taken.
The host approached Morannon, the Black Gate of Mordor.

question: Comment l’utilisation des palantíri a-t-elle influencé Saruman, Aragorn et Denethor ?
justification: Les documents présentent les palantíri comme des outils de communication et d’observation, puis montrent leurs effets différents sur Saruman et Denethor.

references.passage: The palantíri were stones used in communication and to see across the world.
Saruman used his palantír and was eventually ensnared through it by Sauron.
Saruman was seduced by Sauron while peering into the palantír.
Denethor clutched a palantír as he burned.

question: Comment la Guerre de l’Anneau se prolonge-t-elle dans la Comté après la chute de Sauron ?
justification: Ces documents montrent que la fin de la guerre ne met pas immédiatement fin aux violences : Saruman contrôle la Comté avant sa libération par les Hobbits.

references.passage: The War of the Ring was the great conflict at the end of the Third Age.
A gang of Men had taken over Hobbiton and the Battle of Bywater followed.
Saruman was the mysterious boss Sharkey controlling the Shire.
The Shire was liberated after Frodo, Sam, Merry and Pippin returned.
